name: WaterTableCheck
dataset: USGS National Water Information System (NWIS) groundwater levels + National Groundwater Monitoring Network (NGWMN)
heroHeadline: Is the water table dropping where I live?
heroLede: Depth-to-water trends from USGS long-term monitoring wells, county by county, en route to 1,529 wells covering 1,449 of 3,222 US counties. Where no well has a long enough record, this site says so instead of guessing.
